title: Press Room and Media Hub
intro: Official background materials, brand assets, and press inquiry contacts for journalists and editors covering optics and photonics in Egypt.

boilerplate.title: Official Boilerplate (About Optica Egypt Local Section)
boilerplate.body: Approved by Optica on 10 September 2026, the Optica Egypt Local Section connects university students, academic researchers, faculty, and engineering practitioners across Egypt with the international optics and photonics community. Operating under Optica local section bylaws, the section supports open-source computational education, campus student chapter development, technical seminars, and collaborative dialogue across Egyptian academic and technical institutions.
boilerplate.short: Approved on 10 September 2026, the Optica Egypt Local Section connects students, researchers, faculty, and professionals in Egypt with the international optics and photonics community.
